title: Strict boundary resolution of an excellent Noetherian log regular pair
statement:
Let $M$ be an integral excellent Noetherian scheme and $B\subset M$ a nowhere dense closed subset such that $(M,B)$ is a log regular pair. There exist an integral regular Noetherian scheme $R$, a proper birational morphism $e:R\to M$, and a strict normal crossings boundary $A\subset R$ such that $e^{-1}(B)\subseteq |A|$. Birational means inducing an isomorphism on dense open subschemes. At each point of $R$, on a sufficiently small neighbourhood, the distinct components of $A$ passing through that point have equations $t_1,\ldots,t_s$ which form part of a regular system of parameters; thus $A$ has local equation $t_1\cdots t_s=0$. The empty boundary is allowed.

The notions are [def-pc-integral-scheme], [def-exc-excellent-ring], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-trf-log-regular-pair], [def-weil-regular-scheme], [def-weil-proper-morphism], [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary], [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters].
